authorization: For the W3.1 reference date, a reproducibly evidenced status OUTSIDE_BUNDESLIGA may be represented without creating a fictional club, without deleting the player from the participant roster and without changing the stable player identity. A later return to one of the 18 Bundesliga clubs requires a new positive point-in-time/current-state confirmation for that real club; no new player_id is created.
not_authorized: No fictional club or Joker club_id.
No deletion/recreation of the player identity.
No claim about which club outside the Bundesliga employs the player unless separately evidenced.

governance_context.note: This is a bounded P&I-approved extension for the negative competition-scope state. No new formal DEC/REQ identifier is invented by SSOT2.
